8.name: Pyre Vows
8.desc: Your abilities scorch: all ability damage applies a short burn to enemies struck.
8.hint: Burn stacks with every hit — keep enemies inside your aura.

8.name: Crown of Cinders
8.desc: Elites and bosses you mark take 15% more damage from you.
8.hint: Pairs with your Pathway mark — finish the marked first.

5.name: Lantern of the Sun
5.desc: Vitality you restore above your maximum is stored (up to 30) and shields you.
5.hint: Overheal becomes survival — stack it before gate fights.

5.name: War March
5.desc: Every 10th cast strikes twice at full power.
5.hint: Watch your cast rhythm — big hits land on the tenth beat.

2.name: Final Verdict
2.desc: Your signature ability also detonates all burns on enemies it touches.
2.hint: Flame of Purification becomes the ender — bank burns, then purify.

2.name: The Unconquered Sun
2.desc: While at full vitality, all ability damage +25%.
2.hint: Perfection demands perfection — guard your health bar.

8.name: Glyph Memory
8.desc: Chain abilities reach 2 more enemies and never lose damage over distance.
8.hint: Your threads bind wider crowds — fish for chains in packs.

8.name: Thrice-Veiled
8.desc: Tome Shield holds one extra ward and recharges 20% faster.
8.hint: A scholar never travels with one page of defence.

5.name: Star Map Spread
5.desc: Reveal also draws in coins and reagents near the edge.
5.hint: The map shows wealth, not just wisdom.

5.name: Quill of Foretelling
5.desc: +1 Fate reroll at every draft while you hold fewer than six abilities.
5.hint: Write and rewrite — until your book is full.

2.name: The Hidden World
2.desc: Veilstep grants brief invulnerability and leaves a decoy echo.
2.hint: Step out of the world — let the world swing at your echo.

2.name: The Allsage
2.desc: Every 4th-cast bonus is replaced by every 3rd cast.
2.hint: The forbidden name speaks more often now.

8.name: Lullaby Depth
8.desc: Sleep effects hold 50% longer and spread to one nearby enemy on landing.
8.hint: The song carries through the crowd — open with sleep.

8.name: Mirror Nerve
8.hint: Agony is ammunition — take hits early, spend them late.

5.name: Siren Chorus
5.desc: While 5+ enemies sleep nearby, all your ability damage +20%.
5.hint: Conduct the choir — a sleeping field is a dead field.

5.name: Agony Bond
5.desc: Chains bounce 2 extra times and slow everything they touch.
5.hint: Pain that moves is pain that multiplies.

2.name: World as Mirror
2.desc: Mirror World detonates stored wounds at triple value and freezes twice as long.
2.hint: Your signature becomes the answer to everything you endured.

2.name: Apocalypse Whisper
2.desc: Enemies that die asleep deal 30% of your stored wound damage to neighbours.
2.hint: End the song only when everything is sleeping.

dawnbringer.name: Sun Ascension
dawnbringer.desc: Master the Red Priest by burning legions at dawn.

tiers.boon: Elites take +10% more damage from you
Gate bosses take +15% more damage from you

wanderer.name: Ink Ascension
wanderer.desc: Master the Hermit by writing your fate in the margins.

hollow_seer.name: Mirror Ascension
hollow_seer.desc: Master the Demoness by ending what sleeps.

ascension.desc: An Ascended descent re-fights the endgame at rising difficulty for richer rewards. Each tier steps the pressure up; the Study shows your deepest tier.
